tatoeba.en: It was snowing the day I was born.
tatoeba.vi: Trời đang có tuyết rơi vào ngày tôi chào đời.

examples: My holiday was rubbish: there was sod all to do.
wiktionary.gloss: Nothing.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English supplien, borrowed from Old French soupleer, souploier, from Latin suppleo (“to fill up, make full, complete, supply”). The Middle English spelling was modified to conform to Latin etymology.

senses.definition: To provide things that people need or want, such as food, equipment, or services.

examples.en: A local farm supplies fresh vegetables to the supermarket every morning.
examples.vi: Một trang trại địa phương cung cấp rau tươi cho siêu thị vào mỗi buổi sáng.

examples.en: The government supplied the affected villagers with clean drinking water.
examples.vi: Chính phủ đã tiếp tế nước uống sạch cho những người dân trong làng bị ảnh hưởng.

senses.vi: cung cấp; tiếp tế

thesaurus.definition: give something useful or necessary to
circulate or distribute or equip with
give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance
state or say further

vi_block: Thay thế; bổ khuyết, bù (tổn thất... ).

examples: to supply money for the war
wiktionary.gloss: To provide (something), to make (something) available for use.

examples: to supply a furnace with fuel; to supply soldiers with ammunition
wiktionary.gloss: To furnish or equip with.

examples: Rivers are supplied by smaller streams.
wiktionary.gloss: To fill up, or keep full.
To compensate for, or make up a deficiency of.
To serve instead of; to take the place of.
To act as a substitute.

examples: to supply a pulpit
wiktionary.gloss: To fill temporarily; to serve as substitute for another in, as a vacant place or office; to occupy; to have possession of.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English supplien, borrowed from Old French soupleer, souploier, from Latin suppleo (“to fill up, make full, complete, supply”). The Middle English spelling was modified to conform to Latin etymology.

senses.definition: An amount of something that is available for people to use.

examples.en: The hospital has a limited supply of oxygen during the crisis.
examples.vi: Bệnh viện có lượng cung cấp oxy hạn chế trong suốt cuộc khủng hoảng.

examples.en: Heavy rain ensured a plentiful water supply for the whole town.
examples.vi: Mưa lớn đã đảm bảo nguồn cung cấp nước dồi dào cho cả thị trấn.

senses.vi: nguồn cung cấp; lượng dự trữ

senses.definition: Food, medicine, and other essential items that are needed to live or travel.

examples.en: Volunteers brought essential medical supplies to the earthquake area.
examples.vi: Các tình nguyện viên đã mang vật tư y tế thiết yếu đến vùng động đất.

examples.en: The explorers checked their food supplies before setting off into the jungle.
examples.vi: Các nhà thám hiểm đã kiểm tra đồ dự trữ thực phẩm trước khi khởi hành vào rừng rậm.

senses.vi: đồ dự trữ; nhu yếu phẩm; quân nhu

senses.definition: The amount of goods or services available for people to buy at a particular price.

examples.en: Gasoline prices rose rapidly because demand exceeded the available supply.
examples.vi: Giá xăng tăng nhanh vì nhu cầu vượt quá nguồn cung hiện có.

examples.en: The basic law of supply and demand affects every modern market.
examples.vi: Quy luật cung cầu cơ bản tác động đến mọi thị trường hiện đại.

senses.vi: nguồn cung; lượng cung

senses.definition: The act or process of providing goods, energy, or services to people.

examples.en: The company is responsible for the supply of electricity to rural homes.
examples.vi: Công ty chịu trách nhiệm về việc cung cấp điện cho các gia đình ở nông thôn.

examples.en: Bad weather interrupted the supply of food to remote mountain villages.
examples.vi: Thời tiết xấu đã làm gián đoạn sự tiếp tế lương thực cho các bản làng xa xôi trên núi.

senses.vi: sự cung cấp; sự tiếp tế

senses.definition: A teacher who temporarily takes the place of another teacher who is absent.

examples.en: She worked as a supply teacher before getting a permanent position.
examples.vi: Cô ấy từng làm giáo viên dạy thay trước khi nhận được một vị trí chính thức.

senses.vi: giáo viên dạy thay; người thay thế

thesaurus.definition: an amount of something available for use
offering goods and services for sale
the activity of supplying or providing something

vi_block: Sự cung cấp, sự tiếp tế.
Nguồn dự trữ, kho cung cấp; đồ dự trữ; hàng cung cấp.
Tiền trợ cấp (cho ai để sống); khoản chi phí hành chính (nghị viện).

wiktionary.gloss: The act of supplying.

examples: A supply of good drinking water is essential.
She said, "China has always had a freshwater supply problem with 20 percent of the world’s population but only 7 percent of its freshwater".
wiktionary.gloss: An amount of something supplied.

examples: Supply and demand ebb and flow in a complex interplay.
The supply of timber to the region's mills was lower than expected this month, owing to transport problems posed by wildfires.
wiktionary.gloss: The market force that causes sellers to be both willing and able to sell a good or service, as measured by the amount of that good or service that is currently available to be bought at any given price point; the amount itself.

examples: They are busy laying in supplies for the coming winter.
wiktionary.gloss: Provisions.

examples: to vote supplies
wiktionary.gloss: An amount of money provided, as by Parliament or Congress, to meet the annual national expenditures.
Somebody, such as a teacher or clergyman, who temporarily fills the place of another; a substitute.

blocks.etymology: From supple + -ly.

examples:
Grigory hesitantly took her in his arms to kiss her, but she held him off, bent supply backwards and shot a frightened glance at the windows.
'They'll see!'
'Let them!'
'I'd be ashamed—'
wiktionary.gloss: Supplely: in a supple manner, with suppleness.

idioms.gloss: (of a drug dealer) Using the drugs which one sells, especially to excess.
Scarce, or difficult to find, or purchase.

phrasal_verbs.gloss: To supply or be supplied with drugs to sell.

tatoeba.vi: Nước được cung cấp từ bên ngoài.

tatoeba.en: We have to create an independent supply chain.
tatoeba.vi: Chúng ta cần tạo ra một chuỗi cung ứng độc lập.

tatoeba.en: Good technicians are in short supply in the developing countries.
tatoeba.vi: Các nước đang phát triển đang thiếu nguồn cung kỹ sư chất lượng cao.

tatoeba.en: It's necessary for national security that the supply chain not depend too heavily on Chinese companies.
tatoeba.vi: Điều quan trọng đối với an ninh quốc gia là chuỗi cung ứng không được phụ thuộc quá nhiều vào các công ty Trung Quốc.

wiktionary.gloss: Used to add emphasis, particularly by Catholics.

blocks.etymology: Borrowed from Medieval Latin syllabus (“list”), which arose from accusative plural syllabōs appearing as a corruption of sittybās (accusative plural of sittyba, from Ancient Greek σιττύβα (sittúba, “parchment label; table of contents”)) in a 1470s edition of Cicero's “Ad Atticum” IV.5 and 8, influenced by the stem of Ancient Greek συλλαμβάνω (sullambánō, “to put together”).

senses.definition: a document outlining the topics and plan of study for a school or university course

examples.en: The professor handed out the course syllabus on the first day of class.
examples.vi: Giáo sư đã phát đề cương khóa học vào ngày học đầu tiên.
